snippet.title: Staged - Release Date Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Get ready for some backstage chaos! Staged launches on September 2, 2026.

Team up with up to four players as a crew of goblins taking over an old, abandoned theater in Cologne. Search for props, carry them through tight backstage spaces and work together to recreate stage sets before time runs out.

Bring famous European stories and tales like Hansel and Gretel, Dracula and Frankenstein to life across 18 levels, with physical stage-building gameplay involving props, cranes and lighting.

Wishlist Staged now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534100/Staged/

Launches on Steam September 2, 2026.
